description: This file defines the IRtspClient interface in the WPEFramework project. It declares a virtual interface with methods for configuring, setting up, playing, and tearing down an RTSP client, along with setting and getting parameters.

classes.name: IRtspClient
classes.description: An interface for RTSP client operations, allowing configuration, setup, playback, teardown, and parameter management.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the RTSP client with the given service shell.

methods.name: Setup
methods.description: Prepares the RTSP client with a specific asset ID and position.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback at a given scale and position.

methods.name: Teardown
methods.description: Stops and cleans up the RTSP session.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets a parameter on the RTSP client.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from the RTSP client.

ctags.name: IRtspClient
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL IRtspClient : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
